unitTitle: Adverbs of Frequency - Past Simple - Used to - So - Neither/Nor

pairsWith.noteUz: 2-unit mashqlari: Present Simple/Continuous, Past Simple, uch zamon aralash, used to.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 2-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (12-bet, PDF 11). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '2'.

CHAP USTUN:
5) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple or present continuous.' A: Carlos 1) ...... (fly) to Italy next week. B: Where 2) ...... (he usually/stay)? A: When he 3) ...... (go) there, he 4) ...... (always/stay) with his cousin. B: Why 5) ...... (he/go) there? A: He 6) ...... (study) at University. B: 7) ...... (he/come) back to England? A: Yes, after he 8) ...... (finish) his exams next month.
6) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past simple.' 1 A: ...... (you/go) on holiday last summer? B: Yes, I ...... (go) to Hungary. 2 A: Where ...... (be) you last night? B: I ...... (meet) a friend for dinner. 3 I ...... (call) her house but there ...... (be) no answer. 4 Yesterday, Sue ...... (receive) a package in the post from Tom. 5 A: What ...... (you/do) when you ...... (finish) school? B: I ...... (travel) through Europe. 6 I ...... (send) an e-mail to Marie yesterday and she ...... (write) back immediately. 7 A: ...... (they/go) to the football game on Saturday? B: No, they ...... (watch) it on TV. 8 A: ...... (you/finish) the book I ...... (give) you? B: Yes, I did.
7) 'Read the following note and put the verbs into the correct form of the present simple, present continuous or past simple.' Dear Pam, I 1) ...... (be) sorry I 2) ...... (not/come) to your party yesterday. As you 3) ...... (know) I 4) ...... (go) skiing three days ago. It was fantastic but I 5) ...... (still/catch) a terrible cold! I 6) ...... (still/lie) in bed with a temperature! That's why I 7) ...... (miss) your party. Julie 8) ...... (tell) me it 9) ...... (be) great. Call me as soon as you can. Love, Alison

O'NG USTUN:
8) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past simple.' 1 A: Where ...... (you/go) last weekend? B: I ...... (visit) my grandparents on their farm. A: ...... (you/enjoy) yourself? B: Oh, yes! A: What ...... (you/do)? B: Well, on Saturday I ...... (go) swimming and on Sunday I ...... (help) my grandfather milk the cows. 2 (SURAT: keksa kishi ko'zoynakda - Uncle Tom) A: Uncle Tom, how ...... (you/spend) your time when you ...... (be) young? B: First of all, we ...... (not/have) a television so we ...... (play) a lot of games. A: Really! What else ...... (you/do)? B: Well, we ...... (listen) to the radio and ...... (read) books.
'Used to':
9) 'Ten years ago Jerry was a student. Now he is a lawyer. Use the prompts to ask and answer questions about Jerry, as in the example.' THEN: study hard; live with his parents; take the bus to university; wear jeans and pullovers; shop at discount stores. NOW: work hard; have his own house; drive to work in his car; wear suits; shop at expensive stores. A: Did Jerry use to work hard? B: No, he didn't. He used to study hard.

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '12'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the present simple or present continuous.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni present simple yoki present continuous shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
KARLOS ITALIYAGA - REJA va ODAT.

  1 is flying (next week - reja →
    Continuous)
  2 does he usually stay (usually -
    odat → Simple)
  3 goes (When he goes - odat)
  4 always stays (odat)
  5 does he go (sabab so'rash -
    Simple)
  6 is studying (shu kunlarda →
    Continuous; 'studies' ham
    mumkin)
  7 Is he coming (reja → Continuous)
  8 finishes (after he finishes -
    vaqt ergash gapida kelajak
    o'rniga Simple!)


⚠ 'AFTER HE FINISHES':

  Vaqt bog'lovchisidan (after,
  when) keyin kelajak uchun
  Present Simple.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct form of the past simple.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni past simple shaklida qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST SIMPLE - SAVOL, TASDIQ,
  NOTO'G'RI FE'LLAR.

  Savol: Did + ega + fe'l
  Tasdiq: -ed yoki noto'g'ri shakl

  go → went; be → were/was; meet →
  met; send → sent; write → wrote;
  give → gave


⚠ 'THERE WAS NO ANSWER':

  = javob bo'lmadi.


⚠ 'A PACKAGE IN THE POST':

  = pochta orqali posilka.

exercises.explanationUz:
ALISONNING XATI - UCh ZAMON.

  1 am (hozir - holat)
  2 didn't come (yesterday - o'tgan)
  3 know (bilish - his-tuyg'u fe'li
    → Simple)
  4 went (three days ago)
  5 still caught (o'tgan - shamollab
    qoldim)

⚠ 'TO LIE IN BED':

exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI DIALOG - PAST SIMPLE.

  1-DIALOG (dam olish kuni):
  did you go; visited; Did you
  enjoy; did you do; went; helped

  2-DIALOG (Tom amaki yoshligida):
  did you spend; were; didn't have;
  played; did you do; listened;
  read (read → read - yozilishi bir
  xil, o'qilishi /red/)


⚠ 'TO MILK THE COWS':

  = sigir sog'moq.


⚠ 'TO ENJOY YOURSELF':

  = maza qilmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Ten years ago Jerry was a student. Now he is a lawyer. Use the prompts to ask and answer questions about Jerry, as in the example. THEN: study hard; live with his parents; take the bus to university; wear jeans and pullovers; shop at discount stores. NOW: work hard; have his own house; drive to work in his car; wear suits; shop at expensive stores.
exercises.instructionUz: O'n yil oldin Jerri talaba edi. Hozir u advokat. Ko'rsatmalardan foydalanib Jerri haqida savol-javob qiling, namunadagidek. ILGARI: qattiq o'qish; ota-onasi bilan yashash; universitetga avtobusda borish; jinsi va sviter kiyish; arzon do'konlarda xarid qilish. HOZIR: qattiq ishlash; o'z uyi bor; ishga mashinada borish; kostyum kiyish; qimmat do'konlarda xarid qilish.
exercises.explanationUz:
USED TO - SAVOL VA JAVOB.

  A: Did Jerry USE TO + NOW-
     ustunidagi ish?
  B: No, he didn't. He USED TO +
     THEN-ustunidagi ish.

  ⚠ Savolda 'use to' (-d siz),
  javobda 'used to'.


⚠ 'DISCOUNT STORES':

  = chegirmali (arzon) do'konlar.


⚠ 'A PULLOVER':

  = sviter.
exercises.exampleEn: A: Did Jerry use to work hard? B: No, he didn't. He used to study hard.
exercises.exampleUz: A: Jerri ilgari qattiq ishlarmidi? B: Yo'q. U ilgari qattiq o'qirdi.
modelAnswers: 1 A: Did Jerry use to work hard? B: No, he didn't. He used to study hard.
2 A: Did Jerry use to have his own house? B: No, he didn't. He used to live with his parents.
3 A: Did Jerry use to drive to work in his car? B: No, he didn't. He used to take the bus to university.
4 A: Did Jerry use to wear suits? B: No, he didn't. He used to wear jeans and pullovers.
5 A: Did Jerry use to shop at expensive stores? B: No, he didn't. He used to shop at discount stores.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Jerri ilgari qattiq ishlarmidi? - Yo'q. U qattiq o'qirdi. (NAMUNA)
2 Jerrining ilgari o'z uyi bormidi? - Yo'q. U ota-onasi bilan yashardi.
3 Jerri ilgari ishga mashinada borarmidi? - Yo'q. U universitetga avtobusda borardi.
4 Jerri ilgari kostyum kiyarmidi? - Yo'q. U jinsi va sviter kiyardi.
5 Jerri ilgari qimmat do'konlarda xarid qilarmidi? - Yo'q. U arzon do'konlarda xarid qilardi.

patterns.formula: Where did + KIM + go + VAQT? — I + FE'L-ed / NOTO'G'RI ...
patterns.exampleEn: Where did you go last weekend? — I visited my grandparents on their farm.
patterns.exampleUz: O'tgan dam olish kuni qayerga bording? — Buvi-buvamning fermasiga bordim.

patterns.formula: Did + KIM + use to + FE'L? — No, ... didn't. ... used to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Did Jerry use to work hard? — No, he didn't. He used to study hard.
patterns.exampleUz: Jerri ilgari qattiq ishlarmidi? — Yo'q. U qattiq o'qirdi.

patterns.formula: after / when + KIM + FE'L(s) (Present Simple) → kelajak
patterns.exampleEn: He is coming back after he finishes his exams next month.
patterns.exampleUz: U keyingi oy imtihonlarini tugatgandan keyin qaytadi.
